purpose: Apply verified static jump, ordinary ground/air and conditional wall-launch coefficients to the original lab with explicit input/state/runtime assumptions. Not a complete Tenno simulation or measured match.

remaining_fields: Crouch speed3, legacy turn_rate fallback16, slide admission/end and cooldown, hull/collision, roll magnitude/end timing and wall contact/admission retain lab policies. Slide additive channel uses mapped static boost with constructor decay assumption; retaining impulse while blocked and suppressing it during wall latch are explicit lab collision policies. Flat slide base braking and bounded slope target/coefficient composition are mapped for the selected LAB ground-slide admission; full native mode/style/contact selection remains unimplemented. Prior published working normal and native-role supportbit remain separate from actor grounded. Signed gravity uses current pre-aging LAB named modifiers. Scalar normalization approximates native RSQRT refinement; no bitwise float claim. Zero-AccelDrag flat-slide fallback uses lab world-space input and selected cap. With zero alignment drag and zero input, the lab assumes the native ordinary snapshot/reset left working movement zero; special retained-working-vector paths are not reproduced. Aim entry scaling/vertical-dependent gravity and ordinary resource update order now follow recovered arithmetic; live admission, shared wall transition modes and game scheduling remain approximate. Wall vector/height and conditional timing arithmetic now use the recovered finite kernel; this preset supplies static wall coefficients with constructor and identity-stat assumptions. Deprecated fixed wall-speed keys are ignored and behavior changes as described in wall_configuration_migration.

wall_configuration_migration.legacy_loading: Old JSON remains accepted by serde. Unknown wall_jump_horizontal_speed, wall_jump_vertical_speed and wall_jump_cooldown are ignored; absent nested wall_jump loads constructor-backed kernel defaults. This is a behavior change, not preservation of the previous fixed normal*8 / vertical9 / .2-second cooldown behavior.
wall_configuration_migration.static_preset_behavior: This preset explicitly supplies the full kernel configuration, combining own Tenno coefficients with labeled constructor-only fields and identity stat assumptions. Subtype1/2/3/4 select mapped IdealJumpTime NONE/UP/LEFT/RIGHT values; own DOWN=.5 is not separately used by this kernel. MinimumTimingBasedJumpMultiplier1 makes the timing factor1 for this static preset.
wall_configuration_migration.limits: Lab wall admission uses axis-aligned side contact while airborne; native state5/B43 bullet redirection, role/contact gates, post-vector service mutation, effect/root-motion and exact scheduling remain unimplemented. Launch target is height with sqrt/max scalar handling; ongoing wall gravity uses a separate named channel. No runtime capture or measured reference fit.
